svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Annual revenue of Amazon, Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta, fiscal 2020 and fiscal 2025
svg.desc: A chart of paired bars in billions of dollars, fiscal 2020 then fiscal 2025, each row labeled with the firm's logo: Amazon 386 and 717; Apple 275 and 416; Alphabet 183 and 403; Microsoft 143 and 282; Meta 86 and 201. The five together rose from 1,072 to 2,019.
